title: LatComm: Reusable Context Compression for Latent Communication between Large Language Models

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26840）：LatComm 解决的问题很具体——'When the context is passed between models as text, the receiving model processes all of its tokens again for every question'。方法核心是把编码与读取拆开：'separating encoding from reading: the context is encoded once without the question, and the receiver selects what to read for each question'；冻结的 context encoder 压成 fixed-size packet，冻结的 receiver 通过 cross-attention 读取，且 'with gates computed from its prompt'。数字：'LatComm improves average accuracy over single-vector baselines by up to 10.2 points'（12 个 MCQ 数据集平均）；在 QuALITY 上 'it reduces the receiver's input by 57x and answers the questions of an article 3x faster'。价值路由：这是今日唯一一篇直接命中多模型串联系统里重复烧 token 这张真实账单的论文，属 context-engineering × inference-serving 的趋势资产。边界必须写清：latent communication 要求两端模型冻结且可挂 cross-attention，实际接入要改 receiver 架构，摘要提到的 'readable by a different LLM' 的泛化范围论文未给出。代码 / benchmark / 项目页：暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无）。今日动作：记录为 context-engineering 趋势候选，触发条件是出现可即插即用的实现。
